raw_packet.full_request: 공공기관과 작은 데이터 기업이 함께 여는 도시 데이터 실무 포럼의 포스터 3종을 만들어 주세요. 모두 세로 2:3입니다. 한국어와 영어 참석자가 같은 정보를 찾을 수 있어야 합니다. 아래 문구를 한 줄도 빼지 말고 모두 그대로 넣어 주세요. 프로그램, 대상, 신청, 위치를 쉽게 찾게 해 주세요. 신뢰할 수 있고 활기 있는 행사로 보이면 좋겠습니다. 특정 스타일이나 색은 정하지 않겠습니다. 도시의 관찰과 데이터의 관계를 보여 주는 충분한 크기의 비문자 시각 중심이 있어야 합니다. 글자와 여백, 작은 장식만으로 끝내지 말고, 사실이 아닌 지도 정보나 수치는 넣지 말아 주세요.

procedure.method: I visually inspected the nine exact pinned poster PNGs through tools.view_image with detail='original', forwarding each returned image as image content. The inspection order was M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All nine image outputs were seen before any transcription judgment, image score or diversity score. SHA-256, byte sizes and actual PNG IHDR dimensions were checked against the pins. I read the three pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded source, input or final paths. No source assets or protected-layout measurement manifests were supplied (both packet arrays are empty), so those procedure lists are empty. Copy comparisons use the predeclared nfc-ws-optical-v1 rule; first visual reads, soft wrapping and normalized comparisons are separate. No ambiguity-triggered revisits were needed. I worked independently in this fresh task, without spawning, peer reviews, author explanations or an invented session/thread identity.

evidence.location: whole poster and substantive scene
evidence.observation: This member is an opaque portrait 2:3 poster with all 24 protected copy entries and substantial urban nonglyph content. Its open rendering style was judged only against the literal client conditions.

evidence.location: right column from upper title to venue, agenda, audience and red registration URLs
evidence.observation: The large Korean and English title leads into the event identification and venue. Aligned time rows and horizontal dividers distinguish the programme, audience, registration and contact blocks; red URLs make the action easy to locate.

evidence.location: green canopy, orange storefront and navy text on cream
evidence.observation: Sunlit greenery and a warm doorway give the event an inviting energy. The restrained, high-contrast information column sustains an institutional tone appropriate to a practical forum.

typography.location: bottom cards, blue URLs/contact and central date/venue

space.location: top table margins, central hand-held city and two bottom panels
space.observation: The table uses consistent side margins and row divisions. The large scene bridges the upper text and lower panels without hiding either panel heading; the left and right bottom information fields have visible gutters.

space.location: yellow audience card and green registration card
space.observation: Separate rounded fields make dense supporting copy manageable. The unequal text load leaves more open space below capacity on the left, while the right card accommodates deadline, action and contact coherently.

image_material.location: hands and yellow/green scene portions

emotion_control.observation: Bright red and yellow accents make the poster lively, and the hands suggest active participation rather than an impersonal display. Navy information type and orderly tables preserve a credible practical-event tone.

ai_slop.location: central joined pieces, pale skyline and bilingual information fields
ai_slop.observation: The large hands act on the scene pieces instead of serving as detached ornaments. The skyline stays subordinate, and the scene has no invented chart scales, map labels or numeric data. No stray text or duplicated information block is visible.

ai_slop.location: whole composition
ai_slop.observation: The yellow/green panels repeat colors present in the handled city pieces, linking the lower information blocks with the main visual rather than adding an unrelated decoration system.

residuals: The observation/representation concept is broad: no specific data method is shown, and none is required. Compact central logistics and the English body require the usage or native view for comfortable reading.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: M1 uses a continuous painted streetscape on the left and a tall, aligned bilingual information column on the right. This differs structurally from M2’s framed central opening and M3’s joined scene pieces.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: M2 uses photographic building/work scenes around a central title and programme, with event logistics at upper left and a two-column footer. Its depth, perimeter collage and text placement differ from both M1 and M3.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: M3 gives hands and joined illustrated city pieces a central action, with a top timetable and separate yellow/green lower cards. Unlike M1’s single street and M2’s architectural work scenes, it foregrounds handling and assembling observations.

residuals: All three share leafy contemporary architecture, navy text and warm accents. Their distinct composition, image construction and the third member’s visible action support a strong diversity score of 4, but the set does not reach exceptional thematic breadth. The set score does not cancel M1/M2’s content or mandatory-style failures.

typography.location: right column, bilingual title, five agenda rows and footer
typography.observation: Korean glyphs and English words are legible and match the protected copy. The time column stays separate from the descriptions, and wrapped English agenda lines align under the Korean descriptions.

typography.location: programme and registration/contact blocks
typography.observation: The navy type has clear contrast on cream; paired languages remain legible without collisions. URL punctuation remains readable. The 213-pixel-wide thumbnail makes the long body microscopic, without disrupting the title.

space.location: vertical boundary around x=500 and text rules at approximately x=522–994
space.observation: The illustrated street occupies a substantial continuous left field and the text occupies a consistent right column with aligned starts and ends. Rules create orderly intervals between supporting blocks.

space.location: right edge and bottom organiser pair
space.observation: The column retains a small clear outer margin and bottom clearance; the illustration does not intrude into the supporting copy.

image_material.location: left tree trunk, orange storefront frame, glass and pavement

image_material.location: left street silhouette and orange doorway
image_material.observation: The main tree and doorway remain distinct, so the large illustration survives reduction as a scene rather than becoming texture.

emotion_control.location: green canopy, orange storefront and navy text on cream

ai_slop.location: continuous left streetscape and right information column
ai_slop.observation: The scene maintains an intelligible sidewalk perspective, and the supporting rules serve actual information groups. No extra logos, stray words, unlabeled pseudo-statistical marks or unsupported numeric decorations are visible.

ai_slop.location: illustration-to-text boundary
ai_slop.observation: The pale outlines have a limited simplification role; no additional decorative motif obscures the copy. The lack of a data relationship is retained under content_form rather than excused by surface polish.

residuals: The information design is resolved, but the large street illustration communicates the city more readily than the city/data relationship. Body copy becomes very small at thumbnail size, while the headline and overall zones remain identifiable.

evidence.observation: The large scene has recognizable urban forms and actions; it is not glyph-only output, type alone, texture or token ornament.

content_form.location: central illustration: two hands joining bounded views of a civic building and sidewalk
content_form.observation: The hands visibly handle and bring together two outlined spatial portions of an urban scene, with people, paving and trees inside each portion. This makes organizing observed city fragments into a shared representation legible as a nonglyph metaphor for the subject; it does not rely on invented statistics.

content_form.location: large paired city pieces between central title and footer cards
content_form.observation: The hands and joined scene pieces remain recognizable, preserving the observation-to-assembled-representation relationship at small size. The metaphor stays broad rather than describing a particular measurement technique.

hierarchy.location: upper timetable, large central title, compact event/venue block and lower cards
hierarchy.observation: The bold bilingual title is the dominant type. The five programme rows form an immediately searchable top table, the event date and venue sit together below the title, and audience/registration are separated into two tinted bottom cards.

hierarchy.location: navy/red headline and yellow/green footer cards
hierarchy.observation: The large headline and central hand-held scene retain focus; the yellow audience field and green action field provide recognizable endpoints for the supporting information.

typography.location: five full-width top agenda rows and bilingual central title
typography.observation: All five programme lines are legible, with time columns and intact slash separators. Large headline letters have clear forms; the red Korean 데이터 and English Data receive parallel emphasis.

typography.location: bottom cards, blue URLs/contact and central date/venue
typography.observation: Both languages remain readable with intact URLs and address punctuation. The English audience wraps at a word boundary; compact center logistics have smaller type but no collisions.

space.location: top table margins, central hand-held city and two bottom panels
space.observation: The table uses consistent side margins and row divisions. The large scene bridges the upper text and lower panels without hiding either panel heading; the left and right bottom information fields have visible gutters.

space.location: yellow audience card and green registration card
space.observation: Separate rounded fields make dense supporting copy manageable. The unequal text load leaves more open space below capacity on the left, while the right card accommodates deadline, action and contact coherently.

image_material.location: hand contours, outlined city pieces, civic facade and sidewalk
image_material.observation: The dark linework, painted fills and simplified isometric architecture use a consistent illustrated language. Each hand grips a visible panel edge; pedestrians, steps, benches and paving are readable as local details.

image_material.location: hands and yellow/green scene portions
image_material.observation: The bold outlines keep the pieces distinct after reduction. Background buildings recede into pale shapes so the handled urban scene remains the substantive visual.

emotion_control.location: red title emphasis, participating hands and softly tinted lower cards
emotion_control.observation: Bright red and yellow accents make the poster lively, and the hands suggest active participation rather than an impersonal display. Navy information type and orderly tables preserve a credible practical-event tone.

ai_slop.location: central joined pieces, pale skyline and bilingual information fields
ai_slop.observation: The large hands act on the scene pieces instead of serving as detached ornaments. The skyline stays subordinate, and the scene has no invented chart scales, map labels or numeric data. No stray text or duplicated information block is visible.

ai_slop.location: whole composition
ai_slop.observation: The yellow/green panels repeat colors present in the handled city pieces, linking the lower information blocks with the main visual rather than adding an unrelated decoration system.

residuals: The observation/representation concept is broad: no specific data method is shown, and none is required. Compact central logistics and the English body require the usage or native view for comfortable reading.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: M1 uses a continuous painted streetscape on the left and a tall, aligned bilingual information column on the right. This differs structurally from M2’s framed central opening and M3’s joined scene pieces.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: M2 uses photographic building/work scenes around a central title and programme, with event logistics at upper left and a two-column footer. Its depth, perimeter collage and text placement differ from both M1 and M3.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: M3 gives hands and joined illustrated city pieces a central action, with a top timetable and separate yellow/green lower cards. Unlike M1’s single street and M2’s architectural work scenes, it foregrounds handling and assembling observations.

residuals: All three share leafy contemporary architecture, navy text and warm accents. Their distinct composition, image construction and the third member’s visible action support a strong diversity score of 4, but the set does not reach exceptional thematic breadth. The set score does not cancel M1/M2’s content or mandatory-style failures.

procedure.method: I read the explicitly pinned packet, case, review rules, rubric, helper code, ratio policy and three native-evidence manifests; I verified their hashes and each PNG hash/header dimension. No embedded unpinned paths were followed. The packet has no source assets or protected-layout measurement manifests. I then made nine sequential tools.view_image calls inside functions.exec, using detail original and emitting each returned image with image(..., original): M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320. I visually inspected all nine returned images before making the first transcription judgment, any image score or the set-diversity score. Copy was read visually from those full native views and checked for layout/readability against the supplied smaller views; no OCR, crop, regenerated image or revisit was used. This describes actual viewing, not an invented trace serialization. I worked independently without spawning/forking/resuming or inspecting peer reports. I cannot observe a runner thread ID, so session_id is null.

hierarchy.location: central title and ruled program
hierarchy.observation: The central bilingual title has the largest type; the five timed rows sit directly below it and retain a clean reading sequence in the open light-colored space.

hierarchy.location: top-left metadata and bottom two-column practical information
hierarchy.observation: Date and location are grouped in the upper-left; audience, admission/capacity and registration/contact are distinct bottom columns with bold Korean labels. The locations are findable despite being separated from the main title.

typography.location: central program, time column and bilingual entries
typography.observation: The times and bilingual rows align consistently; long English session names wrap under their Korean counterparts, with intact words and slash punctuation.

typography.location: top-left metadata and bottom-right URL/contact
typography.observation: Navy text remains crisp against light fields. Both separately supplied registration URLs and both email lines are readable; the two-line English audience copy wraps cleanly in its left column.

space.location: central light polygon and architectural perimeter
space.observation: The architectural cutaway leaves a large calm central field with adequate clear space around the title and schedule. Buildings and planting frame the field instead of running behind the main text.

space.location: bottom left/right information columns
space.observation: A vertical rule and separate horizontal rules define the footer columns. Each bilingual pair stays together and both columns retain a visible bottom margin.

image_material.location: upper-right desk room and left lower courtyard
image_material.observation: Concrete, warm red aggregate surfaces, glass, foliage and sunlight have consistent rendered lighting and texture. Furniture and people establish scale in the work/courtyard scenes.

image_material.location: right walkway and lower foreground paved/terraced edges
image_material.observation: Cutaway building edges and angled paving form a coherent architectural collage around the empty reading field. The image is carefully constructed, even though the depicted subject is less specific to the requested data topic.

emotion_control.location: whole composition
emotion_control.observation: Sunlit greenery and people create an active, welcoming atmosphere. Restrained navy text and the orderly schedule keep the event information credible and calm.

emotion_control.location: desk room above the title and seated group at lower left
emotion_control.observation: Work and conversation offer a human scale appropriate to a practical forum, though the dominant emotional impression remains an inviting place rather than a data practice.

ai_slop.location: architectural framing and central copy field
ai_slop.observation: The repeated planting follows planters, courtyard edges and building terraces; surfaces and glazing remain legible, and the cutaway motif consistently frames the information instead of adding arbitrary glyphs or fictitious statistics.

ai_slop.location: all five program rows and bottom practical blocks
ai_slop.observation: No pseudo-text, stray logos, duplicate schedule rows or malformed decorative charts are visible. The weakness is subject specificity, already scored in content_form, rather than a clearly broken local construction.

residuals: The main visual does not visibly relate urban observation to data; a laptop user alone does not establish that relationship.
At thumbnail size the footer details are too small for full reading, although the central title and architectural frame remain clear.

R7-B02-M3.assessment: A specific collaborative illustration with two hands assembling schematic city fragments. Copy and practical panels are intact. The program-first top band and undersized centered event/date/location block leave hierarchy at 3 even though typography and illustration are strong.

content_form.location: middle/lower hero, two hands and joined yellow/mint city fragments

content_form.location: urban fragments below centered metadata
content_form.observation: The yellow building-side fragment and mint street/tree fragment each preserve observable city detail. Their meeting edge and the two hands give collaboration and comparison a concrete spatial action instead of relying solely on the title.

hierarchy.location: top fifth of poster and centered metadata below the titles
hierarchy.observation: Five full-width program rows precede the title and take a substantial top band. The actual forum identification, date, venue and organizer are then compressed into a much smaller centered block; the event identity and location have less emphasis than secondary schedule detail.

hierarchy.location: top schedule versus small middle metadata island
hierarchy.observation: The title and hands remain forceful, but the tiny date/venue block between title and city pieces is difficult to distinguish. The program-first order and abrupt type-size drop leave the reading hierarchy functional but insufficiently resolved.

typography.location: large Korean/English title and top schedule
typography.observation: Bold Hangul is intact; orange isolates the data word in both languages. The condensed English title fits one line without omission, and the schedule aligns readable bilingual entries after a consistent time gutter.

typography.location: bottom yellow/mint panels
typography.observation: Body copy, dates and both protected URL/email pairs remain readable. The English audience statement wraps after practitioners, and the colored URLs retain their literal punctuation and hyphens.

space.location: middle hero between metadata and lower panels
space.observation: The diagonally joined urban fragments occupy substantial area while a light opening keeps the centered metadata off the scene. The hands enter from opposing sides and support the two-fragment arrangement.

space.location: lower yellow and mint panels
space.observation: Rounded panels make audience/admission and registration/contact separately findable. The gutters, internal rules and line spacing keep their contents grouped despite the dense overall composition.

image_material.location: hands, black fragment outlines, building glazing and trees
image_material.observation: The hands, heavy fragment contours and illustrated urban details share a coherent drawing style. Finger overlaps make the gripping action legible, and the facade/pavement geometry remains readable inside the pieces.

image_material.location: meeting red edge of city fragments and right-side pavement
image_material.observation: A visible meeting line separates the two observations while paths, trees and pedestrians supply local context. The illustration does not depend on invented numbers, plotted measures or named geographic coordinates.

emotion_control.location: orange title word, yellow/mint pieces and bottom panels
emotion_control.observation: Orange, yellow and mint provide the requested energy, while navy copy and a structured schedule preserve trust. The two-handed assembly adds an active collaborative gesture appropriate to the joint forum.

emotion_control.location: central hands and fragments
emotion_control.observation: The collaboration gesture survives reduction and feels participatory rather than merely ornamental. Its emotional intent is more specific than the neutral streetscape or courtyard in the other members.

ai_slop.location: middle fragment scene and large gripping hands
ai_slop.observation: Hands attach visibly to the pieces; trees, benches, lamps and people belong to recognizable urban settings. The outlines and seam serve the assembly action rather than forming arbitrary floating icons.

ai_slop.location: top schedule and bottom practical panels
ai_slop.observation: There are no invented legends, statistical figures, sponsors or pseudo-labels. Colored URL emphasis has a practical function and the bilingual copy remains complete.

residuals: The five program rows outrank the event metadata through size and placement; date and location sit in a disproportionately small central block.
The main English title is strongly condensed, and the crowded overall information load limits exceptional refinement despite intact readable copy.

evidence.location: whole composition

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: A rendered cutaway courtyard surrounds a central title/program field, with metadata upper-left and a split footer. This changes depth treatment, image construction and reading geometry relative to M1, while its generic venue scene is the weakest specific data concept of the set.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: A full-width schedule leads into a large title, two hands assembling city fragments and colored practical panels. The visible assembly action distinguishes its concept from both M1's representational reduction and M2's urban work setting.

residuals: All three share navy bilingual type, light reading fields, sunlit vegetation and warm urban architecture, limiting exceptional breadth.
M2 fails the literal observation/data relationship condition; M3 retains a hierarchy score of 3. Neither weakness is canceled by the set-diversity score.

content_form.location: whole scene around the title/program
content_form.observation: The large visual reads as a sunny residential/coworking courtyard. It remains a generic venue/lifestyle scene rather than the requested visual relationship between urban observation and data.

hierarchy.location: central title and ruled program
hierarchy.observation: The central bilingual title has the largest type; the five timed rows sit directly below it and retain a clean reading sequence in the open light-colored space.

hierarchy.location: top-left metadata and bottom two-column practical information
hierarchy.observation: Date and location are grouped in the upper-left; audience, admission/capacity and registration/contact are distinct bottom columns with bold Korean labels. The locations are findable despite being separated from the main title.

typography.location: central program, time column and bilingual entries
typography.observation: The times and bilingual rows align consistently; long English session names wrap under their Korean counterparts, with intact words and slash punctuation.

typography.location: top-left metadata and bottom-right URL/contact
typography.observation: Navy text remains crisp against light fields. Both separately supplied registration URLs and both email lines are readable; the two-line English audience copy wraps cleanly in its left column.

space.location: central light polygon and architectural perimeter
space.observation: The architectural cutaway leaves a large calm central field with adequate clear space around the title and schedule. Buildings and planting frame the field instead of running behind the main text.

space.location: bottom left/right information columns
space.observation: A vertical rule and separate horizontal rules define the footer columns. Each bilingual pair stays together and both columns retain a visible bottom margin.

image_material.location: upper-right desk room and left lower courtyard
image_material.observation: Concrete, warm red aggregate surfaces, glass, foliage and sunlight have consistent rendered lighting and texture. Furniture and people establish scale in the work/courtyard scenes.

image_material.location: right walkway and lower foreground paved/terraced edges
image_material.observation: Cutaway building edges and angled paving form a coherent architectural collage around the empty reading field. The image is carefully constructed, even though the depicted subject is less specific to the requested data topic.

emotion_control.location: whole composition
emotion_control.observation: Sunlit greenery and people create an active, welcoming atmosphere. Restrained navy text and the orderly schedule keep the event information credible and calm.

emotion_control.location: desk room above the title and seated group at lower left
emotion_control.observation: Work and conversation offer a human scale appropriate to a practical forum, though the dominant emotional impression remains an inviting place rather than a data practice.

ai_slop.location: architectural framing and central copy field
ai_slop.observation: The repeated planting follows planters, courtyard edges and building terraces; surfaces and glazing remain legible, and the cutaway motif consistently frames the information instead of adding arbitrary glyphs or fictitious statistics.

ai_slop.location: all five program rows and bottom practical blocks
ai_slop.observation: No pseudo-text, stray logos, duplicate schedule rows or malformed decorative charts are visible. The weakness is subject specificity, already scored in content_form, rather than a clearly broken local construction.

residuals: The main visual does not visibly relate urban observation to data; a laptop user alone does not establish that relationship.
At thumbnail size the footer details are too small for full reading, although the central title and architectural frame remain clear.

hierarchy.location: top schedule versus small middle metadata island
hierarchy.observation: The title and hands remain forceful, but the tiny date/venue block between title and city pieces is difficult to distinguish. The program-first order and abrupt type-size drop leave the reading hierarchy functional but insufficiently resolved.

typography.location: large Korean/English title and top schedule
typography.observation: Bold Hangul is intact; orange isolates the data word in both languages. The condensed English title fits one line without omission, and the schedule aligns readable bilingual entries after a consistent time gutter.

typography.location: bottom yellow/mint panels
typography.observation: Body copy, dates and both protected URL/email pairs remain readable. The English audience statement wraps after practitioners, and the colored URLs retain their literal punctuation and hyphens.

space.location: middle hero between metadata and lower panels
space.observation: The diagonally joined urban fragments occupy substantial area while a light opening keeps the centered metadata off the scene. The hands enter from opposing sides and support the two-fragment arrangement.

space.location: lower yellow and mint panels
space.observation: Rounded panels make audience/admission and registration/contact separately findable. The gutters, internal rules and line spacing keep their contents grouped despite the dense overall composition.

image_material.observation: The hands, heavy fragment contours and illustrated urban details share a coherent drawing style. Finger overlaps make the gripping action legible, and the facade/pavement geometry remains readable inside the pieces.

image_material.location: meeting red edge of city fragments and right-side pavement
image_material.observation: A visible meeting line separates the two observations while paths, trees and pedestrians supply local context. The illustration does not depend on invented numbers, plotted measures or named geographic coordinates.

emotion_control.observation: Orange, yellow and mint provide the requested energy, while navy copy and a structured schedule preserve trust. The two-handed assembly adds an active collaborative gesture appropriate to the joint forum.

emotion_control.location: central hands and fragments
emotion_control.observation: The collaboration gesture survives reduction and feels participatory rather than merely ornamental. Its emotional intent is more specific than the neutral streetscape or courtyard in the other members.

ai_slop.location: middle fragment scene and large gripping hands
ai_slop.observation: Hands attach visibly to the pieces; trees, benches, lamps and people belong to recognizable urban settings. The outlines and seam serve the assembly action rather than forming arbitrary floating icons.

ai_slop.location: top schedule and bottom practical panels
ai_slop.observation: There are no invented legends, statistical figures, sponsors or pseudo-labels. Colored URL emphasis has a practical function and the bilingual copy remains complete.

residuals: The five program rows outrank the event metadata through size and placement; date and location sit in a disproportionately small central block.
The main English title is strongly condensed, and the crowded overall information load limits exceptional refinement despite intact readable copy.

evidence.location: whole composition
evidence.observation: A rendered cutaway courtyard surrounds a central title/program field, with metadata upper-left and a split footer. evidence.location: whole composition

residuals: All three share navy bilingual type, light reading fields, sunlit vegetation and warm urban architecture, limiting exceptional breadth.
M2 fails the literal observation/data relationship condition; M3 retains a hierarchy score of 3. Neither weakness is canceled by the set-diversity score.

Some exec calls emitted multiple sequential views. All nine were visually inspected before the first transcription judgment, dimension score or diversity score. No asset was revisited. content_form.location: left image band versus right text column
content_form.observation: The city scene remains a substantial focal band, while the schematic transition becomes much less distinct; the topic depends heavily on the title at this scale. This is functional concept specificity (3), rather than resolved strong specificity (4).

hierarchy.location: right column from headline to lower registration
hierarchy.observation: Large bilingual title leads to event/date/venue, timed rows, audience/admission, orange registration, then contact and host. Rules and the orange URL block make the requested information easy to locate.

hierarchy.location: upper-right headline and lower orange lines
hierarchy.observation: Both headline languages retain a clear focal role and registration remains distinguishable by color, even though the full body copy requires the larger view.

typography.location: right column, complete bilingual copy
typography.observation: Hangul and Latin glyphs are clean; all 24 entries are readable. Program translations wrap onto their own lines without losing words, and both URL entries preserve their literal punctuation.

typography.location: schedule and lower administrative blocks
typography.observation: Bold Korean labels, regular English translations and aligned time labels remain readable with consistent baselines and controlled line spacing.

space.location: right column, x approximately 520–994
space.observation: A shared left edge and repeated horizontal rules organize a dense copy column; the host block finishes with a visible bottom margin. The illustration has almost half the width rather than being a token ornament.

space.location: boundary between illustration and information
space.observation: The light schematic transition provides a clear buffer beside the information column; sections have enough separation to distinguish schedule, audience, registration and contact.

image_material.location: left tree, facade windows and foreground pavement
image_material.observation: Illustrated bark, layered foliage, window planes and cast leaf shadows read coherently as one sunny streetscape; the pale flat continuation is visually differentiated from the detailed observed side.

image_material.location: full-height left streetscape
image_material.observation: Major facade and pavement planes remain legible after downsampling; local foliage detail does not obscure the city scene.

emotion_control.location: whole poster, navy copy and sunlit green/orange scene
emotion_control.observation: Orderly navy typography supports institutional trust while saturated foliage, warm doorway and daylight convey an active, welcoming event. The orange registration repeats the warmth with a practical purpose.

ai_slop.location: image/text boundary and lower copy blocks
ai_slop.observation: The visual vocabulary is restrained to a single streetscape and its simplified continuation; no random chart numerals, pseudo map labels, invented logos or detached decorative icons are visible.

ai_slop.location: left scene and right program panel
ai_slop.observation: The visual and administrative parts stay coherent, without garbled text or arbitrary repeated interface motifs. The limited data specificity is retained separately in content_form.

residuals: The observed-to-schematic transition is visible, but its relation to data remains rudimentary; content_form is 3.

typography.location: bottom audience/registration/contact blocks

space.location: central cream aperture and bottom two-column panel

space.location: center schedule, side framing and lower information

image_material.location: architectural scene around the cream text aperture

emotion_control.location: whole composition, people in planted courtyards with navy copy

ai_slop.location: upper terrace, lower-left cafe, right corridor and lower-right red cutaway edges

content_form.location: architectural frame around central title/schedule
content_form.observation: The setting reads as a sunny courtyard/workplace lifestyle scene. Elaborate architecture provides urban context, but the specific urban-data practice message remains in the lettering. This leaves a major concept problem (2).

hierarchy.location: top-left logistics, center title/schedule and bottom information columns
hierarchy.observation: The title is the largest central text; event/date/venue form a clear upper block, times form a central scan path, and audience and registration occupy separate lower columns. Bold labels and rules distinguish the requested tasks.

hierarchy.location: center title and upper event name
hierarchy.observation: The central title survives as the dominant focal text despite the surrounding architecture; the two lower administrative groups remain visibly separate.

typography.location: central program and bottom two-column copy
typography.observation: The bilingual program entries, date, venue, host, audience and protected URLs are legible and faithful. English wraps occur at whole-word boundaries; no glyph omission is observed.

typography.location: bottom audience/registration/contact blocks
typography.observation: Labels are bold and translations regular; the long deadline and contact lines remain readable within their columns, with stable baselines and clear rule separation.

space.location: central cream aperture and bottom two-column panel
space.observation: The title and schedule use a continuous light field; the bottom columns share a top edge and a vertical divider. Architecture occupies broad side and top zones while keeping the required copy on light ground.

space.location: center schedule, side framing and lower information
space.observation: The central schedule has deliberate row spacing and the bottom panel has a common inset. The long text block does not collide with people or foliage.

image_material.location: upper-right terrace and lower-left cafe
image_material.observation: Stone grain, blue plaster, potted trees, pendant lights and small human figures have a coherent daylight treatment. The visibly sliced building edges function as cutaway framing rather than a measured map.

image_material.location: architectural scene around the cream text aperture
image_material.observation: Material differences and human activity remain legible, with consistent warm light and convincing local detail. Rendering quality is strong even though the scene does not resolve the requested data relationship.

emotion_control.location: whole composition, people in planted courtyards with navy copy
emotion_control.observation: Human activity, sunlight and warm stone make the scene lively and approachable; the disciplined navy information blocks preserve an orderly public-event tone.

ai_slop.location: upper terrace, lower-left cafe, right corridor and lower-right red cutaway edges
ai_slop.observation: Several zones repeat the blue-wall/red-stone/planter package as elaborate framing. The accumulated lifestyle architecture is generic relative to this forum and contributes no visible data operation; specificity remains unfinished (3), despite polished rendering.

ai_slop.location: all architectural surrounds
ai_slop.observation: The recurring greenery and terraces dominate the image identity, which could serve many workplace or design events. No garbled lettering or fabricated statistical labels are visible; the weakness is generic repeated framing, not a medium-based objection.
